scientific_integrity: An explicit universal spectral and trigonometric proof is supplied; finite matrix and trigonometric tests are only consistency checks. No independent audit or formal certification was performed. Existing Zak diagonalization is not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The exact minimax and all equality cases concern unweighted consecutive boxcars, critical cyclic Gabor sampling with odd \(b\ge3\), and strictly overlapping lengths \(r>a\). Even fibers, arbitrary windows, and noncritical lattices are not classified. Historical bibliographic priority is not independently certified.
title: Sharp conditioning of overlapping boxcar Gabor bases on odd cyclic fibers
